scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @pngwasi/config-editor && npm run build --workspace @pngwasi/config-editor-react --workspace @pngwasi/config-editor-vue --workspace @pngwasi/config-editor-svelte && npm run examples
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p typecheck && vue-tsc -p typecheck/vue && svelte-check --workspace config-editor-svelte --fail-on-warnings && svelte-check --workspace typecheck/svelte --fail-on-warnings
